phase_prompt.summary: Initial cinematic depiction of tectonic shift with ancient glyphs and crystalline technology.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic, cinematic scene of the Earth trembling as tectonic plates shift beneath a sky illuminated by ancient Ethiopian glyphs; massive stone monoliths etched with luminous runes crack and slide, releasing crystalline shards that refract light into a tapestry of mystic colors; dust swirls, the ground splits open revealing a glowing fissure pulsing with bio‑luminescent energy, hinting at incomprehensible technology hidden beneath the surface, grounded realism, tactile textures, dramatic lighting.
